site.title: Duba wannan shafin
site.text: Abin da ke cikin manufar wannan shafin da wannan sigar ba ta karanta ba, ko take karantawa ta wata hanya, adiresoshin da take ambata, da yadda sabar ke aika kowane fayil. Babu abin da ke barin wannan burauza sai, idan ka nema, buƙata zuwa kowane ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan adiresoshin.
site.unnamed: index.html ba ta ambaton wata manufa ba: wannan ita ce buɗaɗɗiyar siga, ba tare da wani abu da ƙungiya ta saita ba.
site.missing: index.html na ambaton {file}, wanda sabar ba ta aikawa ({status}).
site.chosen: An duba {file}, wanda aka zaɓa a nan, don wannan shafin.
site.fine: Kowane sashe wannan sigar na karanta shi, a yanayin da take karanta shi.
site.unread: Wannan sigar ba ta karanta wannan ba.
site.unreadNear: Wannan sigar ba ta karanta wannan ba. Ko kana nufin {name}?
site.object: Ya kamata ya zama rukunin saituna, cikin { }.
site.list: Ya kamata ya zama jeri, cikin [ ].
site.textValue: Ya kamata ya zama rubutu, cikin alamomin ambato.
site.flag: Ya kamata ya zama true ko false.
site.address: Ba adireshin yanar gizo ba ne.
site.https: Ba adireshin https ba ne: burauzoji suna ƙin http na yau da kullum, sai zuwa wannan kwamfutar.
site.capability: Babu wata iyawa mai wannan suna.
site.noAddresses: Manufar ba ta ambaton kowane adireshi.
site.refused: Kanun Content-Security-Policy na wannan shafin yana ƙin sa.
site.unreached: Babu amsar da wannan shafin zai iya karantawa: ya tsaya, ba a iya kaiwa gare shi daga nan, ko bai yarda da wannan shafin ba (CORS).
site.key: Maɓallin yana buɗe wannan sigar a nan don {organisation}, har zuwa {date}.
site.trial: Maɓallin gwaji yana buɗe wannan sigar a nan don {organisation}, har zuwa {date}.
site.local: Ba a buƙatar maɓalli a wannan kwamfutar.
